To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

1) the OPC technology can be used for the remote real time communication between Automation Studio and a PLC; 2) the OPC server can be used for remote real time control between Automation Studio and the PLC; 3) OPC server can be a useful tool for the communication between the virtual and the real world; 4) the OPC server is a useful tool in order to implement the Industry 4.5.0.
OPC technology can be used for the communication between the PLC and the Automation Studio.
the OPC technology can be used for the communication between a virtual model of a pneumatic robot, implemented in Automation Studio, and the real world, based on the PLC.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the development of the OPC technology in the context of Industry 4.
a new way of implementing real time communication between Automation Studio and a PLC, based on OPC Server, in the context of Industry 4.
the implementation of a remote control for a 3 DoFs pneumatic robot, based on the OPC communication technology.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the OPC Server technology, in the context of this paper, is a good solution for the implementation of a real time communication between Automation Studio and the PLC.
the OPC technology, as an industrial standard, is the right solution for the communication between the virtual and the physical world.

the OPC technology is a good approach in order to implement a communication between a PLC and Automation Studio, and this is a good approach for implementing a real time communication between a PLC with the simulated system in Automation Studio.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the OPC technology is a good solution for real time communication between Automation Studio and the PLC.
we have implemented a real time communication between Automation Studio and a PLC, using OPC Server, which can be used for control of 3 DoF robots.
we have successfully implemented the OPC technology in Automation Studio and we have successfully implemented a 3 Dof robot model in Automation Studio.
The main takeaway from our work is that
OPC is a good candidate to be used in order to connect different systems, in order to achieve the Industry 4. 0 goals.
OPC can be used as a real time communication protocol for control a 3D robot.
the OPC technology is suitable for the real time communication between the PLC and the simulation environment.
